name: impeccable
title_zh: 前端界面先挑刺再动手的改版师傅
tagline_zh: 改版前先做 UX 审计：视觉层级、信息架构、认知负荷逐项过，专治「看着别扭但说不出哪不对」的界面，附具体修改建议。
tagline_en: UX audit before you redesign: visual hierarchy, IA, cognitive load—finds what feels off and tells you exactly.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states. Handles UX review, visual hierarchy, information architecture, cognitive load, acc
why_zh: 不直接给方案，先拆解界面结构，指出问题根源，再谈优化——避免你被花哨样式带偏，改完更乱。
why_en: It diagnoses root causes, not just symptoms, so you avoid cosmetic fixes that make things worse.
limit_zh: 只针对前端界面（网页、仪表盘、表单等），不碰后端逻辑或交互原型；输入需为代码或截图，否则无法分析；产出为文字报告。
limit_en: Only for frontend UI (web, dashboards, forms). Needs code or screenshot input. Outputs text report, no runnable code.
title_en: Frontend UI critic that audits before redesigning
